title: Szechuan Skillet Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir fry made with ancho chillies and served in a skillet. This dish is a unique twist on traditional Chinese cuisine.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tbsp of oil and sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the steak from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of oil, onions, and Szechuan pepper to the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the onions are softened.
Add the ancho chillies to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Return the steak to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the steak is cooked to desired doneness.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
